facts: Sleeper normalization derives canonical roster_slot from native starters/taxi/reserve membership; starters take precedence, then taxi, then reserve, otherwise Bench. It is not a UI badge inference.

Supported current legal-lineup contract excludes stored IR/TAXI/RESERVE and explicit lineup_eligible=False. Diagnostic pools and canonical optimizer use the same boundary. No supported current rule permits a stored player to start without activation.
Freshness excludes those canonical stored/ineligible rows, but retains all other league roster references, including eligible reserves and unknown availability. This is not participation evidence.
Activation to Bench restores the source dependency. Post-trade resulting rosters receive an independent qualification; a formerly stored incoming stale player cannot inherit the pre-trade exclusion.
Atomic compatibility still evaluates every projection leaf. Full source clocks remain separate and complete. Aging and failed refresh remain material.
These conclusions apply to the admitted compatible roster snapshot, not unobserved upstream roster changes. Incompatible or stale snapshots cannot establish fresh current facts.
scope: Source review plus independently reconciled original executed controls. No league eligibility, projection, scoring or admission policy change.
